_comment: Generated by ck-mcp/loot.py. Item pools (Skyrim + DLC + Beyond Skyrim) for dungeons.js chest loot; value = base record value so difficulty bands can slice each pool; p = the provinces the item may be produced or looted in, omitted when the item is Tamriel-wide. Beyond Skyrim's own leveled lists, containers, outfits and cell placements decide what is legal in Cyrodiil; the editor-id and material rules are the fallback.
